svg.aria-label: The notebook's lm_head lines, with handwritten notes. self.lm_head = nn.Linear(config.n_embd, config.vocab_size) creates 65 rows of 128 numbers, plus 65 biases: one row for each possible next letter. x = self.final_ln(x) is the final normalisation, putting the final hidden states on a steady scale. logits = self.lm_head(x) takes the dot product of each hidden state with each row, plus its bias, giving 65 scores, the logits, for the next letter.
svg.text: From MiniGPT.__init__ and MiniGPT.forward (cell 1.5); the handwritten notes are my own reading
